settings.note: Deep-thinking: high temp + excess tokens (NOT the temp 0.3 of prior benchmarks)

key_finding: Deep-thinking settings (temp 1.0, excess tokens) do NOT change average quality vs temp 0.3 (both 6.4/10). They SHIFT where quality goes: code/math/coding tasks score 8/10 (careful step-by-step reasoning helps), but open-ended creative/prose tasks collapse to 3-4/10 because the model enters a meta-reasoning LOOP ('I need to write X... first I should... let me think...') and never emits the actual deliverable, burning the entire 8192-token budget on thinking-about-thinking.
